controls.label: Monochrome
controls.title: Cassini 2012 mosaic, 293 m per source pixel, delivered on the shared 8192 × 4096 layout. Photographed shadows and variable resolution remain; globe Shadows add approximate lighting. Gray grid marks explicit source no-data. Spherical shape approximation.

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.title: Published 2014 infrared–green–ultraviolet composite, photometrically corrected by Paul Schenk. Enhanced colors extend beyond human vision. Source resolution varies; seams and residual photographed shading remain. Spherical shape approximation.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.title: Color shows height above the PDS 531 km reference sphere. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief lighting at true height scale; Shadows adds the shared approximate globe lighting. Cassini SPC model released in 2025, about 1.5 km grid spacing. The globe remains spherical; model detail and accuracy vary.
